text:
Mira (Design): quick question for the compact form pattern: inline-only errors or inline + minimal top summary (collapsed pill) for destructive/required flows? thinking about scanability and keyboard users.
Josh (PM): we should pick a default. analytics show users sometimes miss inline errors when they scan for CTA.
Lee (Eng): collapsed summary is fine. implementation concerns: avoid layout shift and manage focus when it appears.
Sam (A11y): if we include a summary, it must have role="region" and be focusable on submit failure. announce count and list items. inline errors should use role=alert. required markers need hidden text not color-only.
Ava (Frontend): sketch: one-line pill: "Fix 2 issues" with chevron, expands to small list of links. use aria-expanded on toggle and set tabindex on region.
Mira (Design): microcopy: prefer short header "Fix 2 issues" and link text "View details". for destructive modals: Title: "Delete resource" Body: "This will permanently delete X and cannot be undone." Confirm: "Delete resource". typed-confirm only for high-risk.
Josh (PM): agree; let's gate typed-confirm by risk score. also add telemetry: summary_shown, summary_link_clicked.
Lee (Eng): will prototype collapsed summary with reserved space to avoid reflow.
Sam (A11y): on failure, focus summary; Esc closes summary and focus moves to first invalid field. mobile: announce failure + first error.
Mira (Design): poll: collapsed by default? react with :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no.
Ava (Frontend): :thumbsup:
Lee (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sam (A11y): :thumbsup:
Josh (PM): action items: Mira to mock copies; Ava/Lee to prototype; Sam to review a11y checklist; Josh to file telemetry ticket.
(automated) design-bot: created ticket D-4320 "Compact form validation: collapsed summary + typed-confirm gating" assigned to Mira.
